name: WE_MaskedGGH15
title: Masked and positional gamma-tensor GGH15 WE candidates: secrets, left vectors, laws of the open lemmas
description: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedGGH15: CNF branching programs (CVW18 Construction 6.4), the block secrets diag(P (x) R, M (x) S', S), the left matrices J_O, J_C, the mask (r_0 R_*) A_h^mask, the masked candidate's views and WE ciphertext (PR #45), the hybrids of the positional candidate with the reflected-Gray comparator (PR #54), the cut hybrid of PR #55, and the parameter regime (CVW18 Thm 5.7, Lemmas 3.9, 4.4) with explicit losses hopLoss and simCost for stating the open lemmas.
